records.purpose: Copy the client's current server GameRules parameter snapshot into out (caller sets out->size). Read-only: values are what the server sent and the client applied for the current session; they cannot be written through this ABI. generation changes when a new parameter set is applied.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*read)(sco_plugin* self, sc_gamerules_state* out);`
Copy the client's current server GameRules parameter snapshot into out (caller sets out->size). Read-only: values are what the server sent and the client applied for the current session; they cannot be written through this ABI. generation changes when a new parameter set is applied.
records.ownership: Provider owns the snapshot storage; a plain copy crosses to the caller. No allocation, no engine pointer transfer, nothing retained from out.
records.reentrancy: Read-only snapshot copy; no engine re-entry.
records.results: OK snapshot copied, UNAVAILABLE service off, no backend bound, out null or out->size too small, BAD_ARG invalid self.
records.absent_capability: game.gamerules.read defaults false; the table publishes UNAVAILABLE until a host binds a backend grounded on the build's gamerules.params_sync row.
records.cleanup: StopGameRules withdraws the service and clears the bound backend; no engine state to restore (read-only).
limitations: No backend bound in the default production configuration; nothing has run in game.
Snapshot freshness follows provider binding; no push notification of parameter changes in 1.0.
Parameter set covers the quantum-travel gate fields observed in the corpus (F-4.10.196.36804-007/-008); the wider GameRules schema is not exposed in 1.0.
